name: lanvoryn
description: Private, low-latency audio and video for your local network

scripts.test: npm run build -w @lanvoryn/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lanvoryn/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @lanvoryn/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lanvoryn/shared && npm run build -w @lanvoryn/server && npm run build -w @lanvoryn/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @lanvoryn/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @lanvoryn/web
